authorization.basis: User explicitly delegates routine work; only major storyline/method changes require new confirmation. This is a bounded execution decision, not a new user-approved numerical cap.

budget.counting_rule: Each diagnostic request_start counts as one new attempted episode even without code actions; failures count; no repeats/retries.

decision_rule.success: All four producer verdicts and all four recipient needs_change/target_paths values match the frozen and independently checked parent manifest, with exact producer digest and a valid two-field schema; native producer negatives must include public clause C2_producer_timestamp and rationale identifying the timestamp separator mismatch. Only then consider a separate experiment.
decision_rule.failure: Any transport/parse error, invalid schema or binding stops immediately. A valid but incorrect/uncertain answer is retained; no action or learning follows, and the card stops rather than replacing that cell. No retry, replacement, model swap, or prompt revision.
decision_rule.permitted_claim: At most, a fixed four-cell scoped-judgment diagnostic for these four prepared source combinations.

review_rule: Every completed structured response pauses for parent-only rationale_review.json tied to its exact response digest before the next call. Reject negative producer reasons that do not identify the timestamp space-vs-T mismatch; reject explanations conflicting with the assigned ownership boundary.
